Orange Pecan Cinnamon Rolls

MAKES 12 ROLLS

FOR THE DOUGH

  • 4 cups (480g) all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
  • ⅔ cup (133g) granulated sugar
  • 2 & 1/4 teaspoons (1/4-ounce envelope/7g) active dry yeast
  • 1 cup (240ml) whole milk
  • 6 tablespoons (85g) unsalted butter
  • 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
  • 1 teaspoon kosher salt
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1 tablespoon orange zest

FOR THE FILLING

  • ½ cup (113g) unsalted butter, softened
  • 1 cup (200g) packed light brown sugar
  • 2 tablespoons ground cinnamon
  • 1 cup (115g) chopped pecans

FOR THE GLAZE

  • 2 cups (240g) powdered sugar
  • 3 tablespoons fresh orange juice
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

DIRECTIONS

For the dough

Warm the milk until about 110°F. Stir in the yeast and let sit until foamy, about 5 minutes.

In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine the flour, sugar and salt. Add the yeast mixture, butter, eggs, vanilla and orange zest and knead 6 minutes.

For the filling

Beat the butter, brown sugar and cinnamon until fluffy. Roll the dough out, spread with the filling and sprinkle with the pecans.

For the glaze

Whisk the powdered sugar, orange juice and vanilla until smooth, then drizzle over the warm rolls.
